Definition: perhaps a primary word; the marrow:--marrow.
BiblicalUsage: Myelos is marrow — the word of God is quick and powerful, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the marrow is the deepest place the word reaches: it does not stop at the skin, it divides what nothing else can divide.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
